title: Remote scalar device heals Herrera

tellings.quote: So, the first scan took 12 12 and a half hours. I was in this chair and they were sitting there working like literally overnight.

plain: Michael Herrera, a guest who says he once saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says he was treated from a distance with a 'scalar' device, a kind of healing machine whose workings the telling does not explain. He tells Michels it happened to him: the first scan took 12 to 12 and a half hours, with him sitting in a chair while the people running it 'were sitting there working like literally overnight.' If true, it would mean a machine can heal someone without ever touching them.
